card.name: Wording about lab assay methods
card.fires_on: Small words and word parts just before a named laboratory test method, such as 'by the', 'when an', 'using' or 'enzym-atic', in lab-test interference or creatinine and phosphorus measurement passages.

modes.label: Linking word before method
modes.description: A small word like the, an, using or with that introduces the assay method used.
